claims: The Artemis II crew successfully splashed down in the Pacific Ocean off the coast of San Diego, California.
The Artemis II crew splashed down on Friday, April 10, 2026.
The Artemis II crew splashed down at approximately 8:07 p.m. ET (5:07 p.m. PT).
The Artemis II crew is a four-person crew.
The Artemis II crew completed a 10-day mission around the moon.
The Artemis II mission was a lunar flyby.
The Artemis II mission was not a moon landing.
The Artemis II crew consists of NASA astronauts Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and CSA astronaut Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II crew are safe.
NASA aims to land the first astronauts on the moon for the Artemis program by 2028.
